verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on 2 Kings 22

Josiah king at eight after Amon's assassination; 2 Chr 34 has a commitment at 16 and a purge four years later (Wiseman: the two-stage sequence may suit the Chronicler's emphases); Jeremiah identified as son of this Hilkiah (Jer 1:1); law book possibly Deuteronomy (Wiseman: Josiah's acts depend on it) or Deut 28–31 (Clarke), even Moses' autograph (Clarke); Huldah otherwise known only from 2 Chr 34:22; Zephaniah active (Wiseman); "in peace" explained three ways though Josiah died in battle; Knapp: 1 Kgs 13:2 fulfilled after more than three hundred years
